coverage.rule: A value from a row whose coverage is under 50% is withheld: null, with a reason next to it.

provenance.definition: Line-scope service-disruption alerts of the last 24 hours: the public MBTA header text, the affected stations and segments
sql: select alert_id, effect, header_text, strftime(first_seen at time zone 'UTC', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') as first_seen, strftime(last_seen at time zone 'UTC', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') as last_seen, is_active, n_stations, from_station_name, to_station_name, segment_keys from read_parquet('<gold_snapshot>/gold/agg_service_disruptions.parquet') where line = 'Green-B' order by is_active desc, last_seen desc, alert_id limit 501
